item.title: Why Should We Push Code Frequently?
item.description:
Why Should We Push Code Frequently?#

You are currently working on the Marvellous Filters assignment.

You are trying different techniques to manipulate Wolverine’s image.

Some techniques work. Some don’t.

But what happens to your previous working code when you try something new?

What If Your Previous Technique Was Better?#

Suppose you’re working on Sentinel assignment.

After experimenting for some time, you manage to flip Wolverine’s image upside down.

It works!

But you think there might be a simpler way to implement it.

item.title: Intro to Git/GitHub
item.description:
So far, whatever the raylib code you wrote has stored on your computer.

Now think about these situations:

  • What if your laptop suddenly stops working?
  • What if you want your code reviewed by mentors or peers, may be during the weekend?
  • What if your laptop gets lost or damaged?
  • What if you want to access your code from another computer?
  • What if you are away from your laptop but need to look at your latest code?

All of these point to the same problem: your code lives in exactly one place.
